rules.message: Browser automation policy: use the agent-browser CLI instead of mcp__claude-in-chrome__*. Run `cmd /c agent-browser skills get core`, then `cmd /c agent-browser <command>`.
Browser automation policy: use the agent-browser CLI instead of mcp__chrome-devtools__*. Run `cmd /c agent-browser skills get core`, then `cmd /c agent-browser <command>`.
Library docs policy: MCP context7 is forbidden. Use the Context7 CLI: `ctx7 library <name>` then `ctx7 docs <id> <query>` (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 on Windows/Git Bash).
Web search policy: WebSearch is forbidden. Use `cmd /c agent-browser` for search/scraping; WebFetch is allowed only for raw JSON/API endpoints.
